fact: GN No. 57, published 28 January 2025 and made under section 165 of the Electronic and Postal Communications Act, adds 'unethical, fabricated and artificial intelligence generated content including video clips, audio and still pictures' to prohibited content.
title: The Electronic and Postal Communications (Online Content) (Amendment) Regulations, 2025
publisher: Ministry of Communications and Information Technology (GN No. 57)
